## Release — backlog-campaign v0.24.2

### ✨ What's new in v0.24.2

#### Release publishing

- Releases now build on a GitHub-hosted runner, so publishing no longer depends on the self-hosted runner being online.
- This is the first published release since v0.23.3. The v0.24.0 and v0.24.1 tags never published because their release jobs had no runner, so this release carries their changes too: see the [v0.24.0](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/blob/v0.24.2/.github/releases/v0.24.0.md) and [v0.24.1](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/blob/v0.24.2/.github/releases/v0.24.1.md) notes.
